newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi sees 10-15 pct Stet in core group.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi sees 10-15 pct Stet in core group.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said 10-15 pct of the capital of state telecoms holding Stet, set for privatisation this year, should go to a stable group of shareholders with the rest put on the market in a public sale offer.

"Ten to fifteen percent will be held by a stable group of shareholders which the government will have to find, and then there will be a public offering for the rest of the share capital," Ciampi said, addressing the Senate (upper house) public works commission.
Ciampi confirmed that the planned merger between Stet and telephone operator Telecom Italia will be completed by June with the privatisation of the new group taking place by autumn.
He said the government was seeking reliable partners for Stet, "ones without bias and therefore without conflict of interests."
Ciampi added that "before or after the sale, but the decision will be taken ahead of it, there will be sell-offs in the manufacturing/information technology sector." He did not elaborate.
